Behind 07-Ghost sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. The series has been adapted into a drama CD and an anime television series from Studio Deen, which debuted in April 2009.

The nihilist does not deny 07-Ghost — he only refuses to flatter it. Teito Klein is a former slave who now attends the Barsburg Empire's military academy due to his ability to use a rare and highly prized type of supernatural force known as Zaiphon. The night before the graduation exam, Teito and his only friend, Mikage, vow they will never abandon each other.

What culture calls destiny in 07-Ghost is usually just selection pressure wearing a suit. Stopping to listen, he suddenly realizes that the speaker, Chief of Staff Ayanami, is the person who killed the familiar man in his dreams: His father, the king of the destroyed Raggs Kingdom. Teito is caught eavesdropping and tries to attack Ayanami but is quickly brought down by one of his subordinates and sent to prison.

The genes do not care about 07-Ghost; they care about copies. Mikage comes to help him escape, only to find that Teito has managed to fight past the guards all by himself. Teito pretends to hold Mikage hostage, then makes his escape, though he is wounded by a Zaiphon blast that Ayanami directs at him.

Take away the meaning and 07-Ghost still functions — that is the disturbing part. Three bishops in the nearby 7th District discover the injured Teito and take him to a nearby church to recuperate, where he's protected because of the 7th District's law of sanctuary. In due time, it is discovered that Teito carries the Eye of Mikhail, a powerful talisman for which his home country was destroyed.

The unconscious does not argue with 07-Ghost; it simply acts first. This fact, as well as a fateful reunion, catapults Teito into a quest for revenge against the Barsburg Empire and for knowledge about his past. At the same time, his status as the bearer of the Eye of Mikhail throws him into the long-standing conflict with the evil Verloren and his enemies, the 07 Ghosts.

07-Ghost feels chosen. The evidence says it was installed. The book is set in the midst of the Barsburg Empire, which is divided into seven districts, each with its own cities, rulers, and culture. Zaiphon is the "magic" of 07-Ghosts world, the ability to convert life energy into various forms of power and is the force which keeps the continent afloat in the sky.

The bleak reading of 07-Ghost is also the most testable one. Zaiphon is controlled by converting strong emotions into power, often taking the shape of words, though people may use weapons to channel said energy. Those who have the ability to use Zaiphon are rare and thought of as having been blessed by God.

Modern psychology keeps rediscovering what the pessimists said first about 07-Ghost. Every user's capabilities are different, and in many cases, reflect their nature. Healing Zaiphon: People with healing Zaiphon are capable of healing wounds as well as sharing and/or transferring their Zaiphon to others.

The self that experiences 07-Ghost is a committee, not a king. Characters who primarily use healing Zaiphon are Labrador, Assistant Archbishop Bastien, Ouka, and Capella. Offensive Zaiphon: People with offensive Zaiphon can strike enemies at different ranges and protect themselves from attacks directed at them.

Reproduction explains more of 07-Ghost than any philosophy dares to admit. Characters who primarily use offensive Zaiphon are Teito, Mikage, Ayanami, Hakuren, Frau, and Capella. Manipulation Zaiphon: People with manipulation Zaiphon (which is even rarer then those who can use Zaiphon) can alter the shape and/or nature of things.

Once you see 07-Ghost as an adaptation, the mystery mostly evaporates. So far, Labrador and Castor are the only known users of this type of Zaiphon. It is possible for a person to use more than one version of Zaiphon; however, people who can successfully do so are few and far between.

The story 07-Ghost tells about itself is the last thing to be trusted. There are a variety of weapons used to manipulate Zaiphon, one of these being the bascule. With the bascule, people can channel their Zaiphon and use it for several purposes.

Meaning is not found in 07-Ghost — it is manufactured for it. Different types of Zaiphon have different effects when used through a bascule: those with healing Zaiphon cannot directly attack a Kor, but they can restrict and remove Kor from afflicted people, and those with offensive Zaiphon can directly attack a Kor. According to a centuries-old myth, the God of Death, Verloren (Dutch or German for Lost), "killed" the daughter of the Chief of Heaven and was forced to escape to the earth.

The cold light on 07-Ghost leaves the facts intact and only the comfort removed. In retribution, Verloren invaded the hearts of the people, who slipped into despair. Lamenting over the people's suffering, the Chief of Heaven dispatched seven heavenly lights in order to punish Verloren.

07-Ghost did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. Called the "Seven Ghosts", they are said to have sealed Verloren on the earth and served forevermore as the guardians of the Empire. Mothers often tell their children that if they are naughty, the Seven Ghosts will come to take them away.

The honest version of 07-Ghost starts by giving up the comforting part. Though Verloren has been sealed away in Pandora's Box for over 1000 years, his messengers, the Kor, find and contact humans to bring them under his influence. If a contract is made, a mark appears on the person's chest.

Strip 07-Ghost of its poetry and the mechanism underneath is stranger. This is known as "Verloren's curse", and it indicates one's heart has been consumed by darkness. One of the duties of the "07-Ghosts" is to fight against Verloren and his curse and stop contracts from being fulfilled.

Evolution does not optimize for happiness — 07-Ghost shows exactly where that breaks. The 07-Ghosts are embodied in humans with such extraordinary Zaiphon abilities that they are considered to be blessed by God. They were originally fragments of Verloren, and they were sent down to the earth by the Chief of Heaven in order to stop Verloren.

What looks like free choice in 07-Ghost is older than choice itself. Each of the 07-Ghosts has died in his previous life, and they all retain their memories of their past lives. Frau, Castor, Labrador, Fea Kreuz and Lance have been revealed to be Ghosts thus far; all of them have the mark of their Ghosts on their hands.

Nobody designed the part of 07-Ghost you experience — it was inherited. The Ghosts' names are Zehel, Fest, Prophet, Landkarte, Reliquie (or Relikt), Eher and Vertrag, all of which have Dutch or German origins. Since all their names come from German, the names have a meaning in this language, and are not just a name.

Every serious account of 07-Ghost eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. For example, it is common to see the name "Randkalt" ("Rand" meaning "Edge" whilst "Kalt" means "Cold") making the name meaningless. On the other hand, the name "Landkarte" means "Map", which corresponds with Landkarte's ability.

Nihilism is not the conclusion of 07-Ghost — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. The same happens with the Ghosts Reliquie/Rilikt and Ea, which are not German words. When a person is given a life from the Chief of the Heavens, they choose three dreams to complete over the course of their lifetime.

The selfish-gene reading of 07-Ghost makes it less romantic and far more precise. When all the dreams are granted, their souls will be called back to the Chief and be reincarnated. However, when people are born they do not remember the dreams they chose, and finding out the dreams is supposedly the joy of life.

Freud is not dead; he is simply no longer allowed to be the whole answer. There are evil beings who want to interfere with this process; among them are Verloren's messengers, the Kor, who steal dreams and drag humans into darkness. When a human's first dream is granted by a Kor, the person's heart becomes unstable and unable to be satisfied no matter what he or she does.

The feeling that 07-Ghost means something is a chemical event with an evolutionary address. When the second dream is granted, the person falls into a state of starvation or addiction. When the third dream is granted, the soul has indulged in too much darkness and becomes forever unable to return to the Chief of Heaven.

Nothing in 07-Ghost was built for you — it was built for reproduction. The Kor then takes the body; a possessed body with all three dreams fulfilled by the Kor is called a Wars (warusa means "evil" in Japanese), and they serve Verloren. A dark magician who can control the Wars is called a Warsfeil.

The psychology underneath 07-Ghost is simpler and older than the story on top. It is the duty of the church to protect people from the Kor, because the feeling of addiction is very difficult to remove. There are cases when a Kor may grant a wish that is not one of the three dreams, but it upsets the equilibrium and the Kor may be punished for it.

Behind 07-Ghost sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. The Eyes of Mikhail and Raphael are a set of holy stones that can be embedded into the body, allowing the Archangels Mikhail and Raphael to descend into a host's body for a limited time. They are undetectable until they possess their host's body, whereupon the stone appears in the host's hand, the host's eye color changes, and they become able to wield godlike powers with Zaiphon.

The nihilist does not deny 07-Ghost — he only refuses to flatter it. Before the storyline of "07-Ghost," the royal family of the Kingdom of Raggs held the Eye of Mikhail and the Barsburg Empire held the Eye of Raphael. A pact was established between both countries never to seize the other Eye; however, the Barsburg Empire broke this pact ten years prior to the storyline.

What culture calls destiny in 07-Ghost is usually just selection pressure wearing a suit. The Eyes' full usages are unknown; however, thus far, the Eye of Mikhail has been used to seal Verloren's original body in Pandora's Box, and the Eye of Raphael has been said to be able to reincarnate Verloren's soul in human bodies. Although the plot is serious, there is a lot of comic relief, giving the story a more lighthearted tone.
